# Comfy HeyGen- Talking Photo

Generate a talking-head video from a single photograph using HeyGen's Avatar IV engine, which produces a fully animated video with lip-synced speech, facial expressions, head movements, and automatic gestures. Ideal for creating digital avatars for presentations, virtual characters for interactive content, and personalized video messages from a single image. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_heygen_talking_photo.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.speech.text: Look through my lens, everything gets warmer.
